messages:
Alex CSM: Quick heads-up — Kestrel Health requested a 90min enablement workshop for next week (20 ppl). They flagged adoption gaps and a renewal risk if we don't show value. Need to lock agenda, prework, and a solid demo. @Maya Enable @Ian Ops any available to lead/run the demo? :warning:
Maya Enable: I can lead. Proposed structure: 30m platform overview, 30m hands-on migration demo, 20m ops + canary routing deep-dive, 10m live Q&A. Suggest +15m optional follow-up office hours for hands-on troubleshooting.
Ian Ops: Good plan. I want to run an infra pre-check — need a test account + sample dataset from the customer. Recommend we demo Dedicated canary routing to show isolation and fallback. I can reserve a Dedicated pool for the demo.
Sophie Product: Add a short "rollback & fallback" mini-section to reassure execs — show runbook + SLA fallback to hosted API. That tends to reduce churn concerns.
Alex CSM: Great. Maya, can you draft the agenda and a 2–3 question prework survey to identify blockers? I'll ping the customer for timezones.
Maya Enable: Drafted and shared (internal): https://redwood.co/surveys/kestrel-prework (mock link). Proposed time slots for workshop (UTC): 2026-03-30 16:00, 2026-03-31 09:00, 2026-04-01 13:00. Which works for the team?
calendar-bot: Poll created: https://calendar.redwood.co/polls/abc123 — react to vote or use the poll link.
Ian Ops: I'll take 2026-03-31 09:00 UTC for infra/demo. Can we block 1 hour before for test prep? Command: `/calendar block 2026-03-31T08:00-09:00Z prep:canary-demo`
Alex CSM: Please ensure the invite includes: prework link, sample dataset S3 path, and renewal health slide deck. Tagging @Sophie Product to provide the deck.
Sophie Product: Uploading deck v1 to drive/shared/kestrel/renewal_deck_v1.pdf — will iterate after Maya's agenda.
Maya Enable: We'll demo a canary traffic routing example + KV cache warmup. Need customer logs access; I've opened ticket CS-4892 for log access and dev keys.
Alex CSM: Also planning a short pulse at the end for feedback + renewal signal: 3 quick questions (ease, confidence, intent). Keep it anonymous.
Maya Enable: Proposed pulse: 1) How confident are you to proceed on migration (1–5)? 2) Any blockers we should address? 3) Want an internal follow-up session? I'll wire a 1-click Google form.
Ian Ops: Mini checklist for presenters: confirm VPN access, upload test dataset, rotate demo keys, verify Dedicated pool pre-warmed, runbook link in invite. I'll post the checklist to the prep calendar event.
Alex CSM: Final ask — please confirm availability by EOD 2026-03-27. If you can present, react with :+1: or suggest an alternate. We should avoid last-minute swaps — customer is on a tight renewal timeline.
Maya Enable: :+1: happy to lead.
Ian Ops: :+1: will handle infra and prep block.
Sophie Product: :+1: will finalize deck slides (rollback & SLA section).
calendar-bot: Event draft saved to team calendar: Kestrel Enablement — waiting on final slot vote.
